From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Private VPC & security questionnaire (next steps)

John — thanks for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security and private deployment items you asked about:

1) SOC 2 / Compliance:
- Current status: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type II for our hosted control plane. For Private/VPC deployments we provide the control-plane evidence + guidance for customer attestation. Laura can share the summary report and our security whitepaper.
- Acme ask: you mentioned needing evidence for your Audit team and timeline for when our controls map to your requirements.

2) Data residency & GDPR/HIPAA:
- We support data residency options via region-specific VPC deployments. For HIPAA workloads we offer BAAs on Private deployments and encrypted at rest by default.

3) Private/VPC & air-gapped options:
- Options: (A) Private VPC (customer VPC peering / PrivateLink) with control-plane integration, (B) On-prem air-gapped package (we ship an appliance image and offline installer), (C) Hybrid with customer-managed gateway.
- Key items to confirm: outbound-only vs fully air-gapped, KMS integration (customer-managed), and network egress rules.

4) Vendor security questionnaire:
- I attached an initial vendor questionnaire template to speed things up. If you prefer we can open a secure questionnaire link and have your team fill it directly.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll attach a high-level Private VPC deployment diagram (see attachment).
- Laura will share our SOC 2 summary & the whitepaper.
- Monica to coordinate a security deep-dive call with your infra/security team next week.

Can you confirm your security contact(s) and whether you prefer the Doc (attached) or the secure link? Also what level of isolation you need (VPC with PrivateLink or fully air-gapped on-prem)?

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: John Park <j.park@acme-analytics.com>

Cc: Acme Analytics Security Team <security@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Private VPC & security questionnaire (next steps)

Thanks Marcus — helpful recap. A few answers and clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: we need the SOC 2 Type II report and the mapping to our security control framework (ISO-derivative). If you can share the summary and the auditor firm name that’ll help our risk team triage.
- GDPR/HIPAA: we will be processing EU customer data for one of our products; GDPR compliance + data residency will be a must. HIPAA is possible for a subset of our customers — we’ll need BAA language and confirmation on encryption-in-transit and at-rest.
- Deployment preference: we prefer a Private VPC with strict egress rules (no public internet egress from the data plane). Air-gapped is a future requirement for certain customers, but initially VPC-only is fine.

Regarding the vendor questionnaire: please open the secure link if you have one. Otherwise we’ll have our security team start on the attached PDF. I’m copying them here.

Also: can your SE run through the network ports and flow diagram? Our infra lead will want to validate NAT/gateway behavior for the control-plane callbacks.

Regards,
John
John Park
Director of Infrastructure, Acme Analytics
j.park@acme-analytics.com

John — I’ll lead the deep-dive. Quick technical notes ahead of the call so your infra lead has context:

- Control plane callbacks: for Private VPC we support an outbound-only control-plane channel over TLS to our control plane. If you need zero egress, our on-prem air-gapped package is the option (requires offline provisioning).
- Ports & flows: 443 outbound from data plane to control-plane endpoint; optional PrivateLink endpoints can avoid public internet. Specific ports for telemetry: 443 and 5222 (if using internal messaging). We’ll provide a firewall ruleset.
- KMS: customer-managed KMS is supported via Cloud KMS or HSM; we can integrate with customer key policies.
- Audit & logs: we stream audit logs to your Splunk/Datadog endpoint or S3 bucket depending on preference; retention is configurable.

I’ll attach a short network flow table and the control-plane IP ranges before the meeting. Agenda for Wed: 1) run through the diagram and firewall rules, 2) KMS and key management questions, 3) SOC 2 evidence and mapping, 4) timeline and next milestones.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
